name: Intercom
look: Cream canvas with charcoal as the system primary, product screenshots leading every section, and one orange reserved for the AI product.

hero.title: The AI-first customer service platform
hero.sub: An AI agent that resolves most conversations on its own, a helpdesk for the ones it cannot, and a shared inbox where both live together.

features.title: One inbox, human and machine
features.sub: The AI agent and your team work the same conversations, with the handover visible to everyone.

items.title: AI agent
items.body: Resolves routine questions from your help centre content, and says it does not know rather than inventing an answer.

items.title: Shared inbox
items.body: One queue for email, chat, social and in-app, with assignment rules and SLAs.

items.title: Help centre
items.body: Articles that feed the AI agent, so improving the docs improves resolution directly.

items.title: Clean handover
items.body: When the agent escalates, the human sees the full attempt rather than starting cold.

items.title: Resolution reporting
items.body: What was resolved, by whom or what, and where the agent gave up.

items.title: Customer context
items.body: Plan, usage and history alongside the conversation, from your own systems.

showcases.title: It knows when to give up
showcases.body: The agent answers from your help centre and its own resolution history, and escalates the moment confidence drops rather than guessing. The rate at which it hands over is reported honestly, because that number is what you tune.
points: Answers grounded in your own content

showcases.title: Measured on resolution, not deflection
showcases.body: Deflection counts people who gave up. Resolution counts people whose problem was actually solved. The reporting distinguishes them, which changes what you optimise for.

gallery.title: RESOURCES
gallery.sub: Guides, integrations and the developer API.

testimonial.quote: Half our conversations never reach a person, and the half that do arrive with the whole attempted answer attached. Our team stopped starting every ticket from zero.
testimonial.name: Marcus Lindgren

pricing.title: PRICING
pricing.sub: Per seat, plus a published rate per AI resolution.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.desc: Adds automation and the AI agent.

items.q: How is the AI agent priced?
items.a: At a published rate per resolution, charged only when the conversation actually ends without a human. Escalated conversations are not billed as resolutions.
Your help centre articles, past resolved conversations and any content you connect. It does not answer from general world knowledge.

items.q: What happens when it does not know?
items.a: It says so and hands over, passing the full attempt to the agent who picks it up. The handover rate is reported per topic so you can see where your content is thin.

items.q: Can we start without the AI agent?
items.a: Yes. Essential is a straightforward shared inbox and help centre; the agent is added on Advanced when you want it.

cta.title: Start resolving faster
cta.sub: Fourteen-day trial, no card, and the AI agent included.

notes: The cream canvas is the defining surface — neither white nor grey, deliberately warm.
Every section centres a product mockup card; the marketing chrome around it stays minimal.
Charcoal is the system primary. Buttons, headlines and body type all sit on it rather than on a brand hue.
The orange belongs to the AI product only — its CTA and its badge. Using it decoratively would dilute the signal.
Display tracking pulls aggressively negative at large sizes while body copy stays at zero.
